responsibility: Implements the standalone gcov-dump utility that decodes and prints raw gcov coverage files for debugging. It opens .gcno and .gcda files using the shared gcov I/O layer, identifies record nesting and tag types, and formats function, block, arc, line, counter, and summary records, with options to show record positions, decoded contents, and raw counter data. Its responsibility is inspection of gcov file structure and payloads, not profile generation or report rendering.
